title: Performance model
brief: Predict decode and prefill floors, search for SLO-constrained goodput, and recover a planted bandwidth fraction from a synthetic trace.
hints: A decode step at batch 1 is memory-bound. The time is the byte term, plus communication, plus the launch floor. The arithmetic peak is the other branch of the max.
Goodput is the best batch in 1..max_batch whose step meets the TPOT SLO, whose prefill meets the TTFT SLO, and whose weights, KV, and state fit. A missed TTFT SLO returns 0.
The fit is a straight line of seconds against bytes/bandwidth. The slope is 1/alpha and the intercept is the overhead. The trace is synthetic: the flops column is there so you can misuse it.
